errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с текст
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is labeled with numerical values (-0.4, 0.0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.2), not a descriptive text label.
The range of the Y-axis shown in the plot is from -0.4 to 1.2, not starting from 0.0.
The labeled tick marks on the Y-axis are at intervals of 0.4 (from -0.4 to 0.0, 0.0 to 0.4, etc.).

errors.text_span: Синята плътна линия започва на стойност приблизително 0.2
errors.evidence: The blue solid line starts at a value closer to 0.1 at x=1, not 0.2.
The blue line reaches a peak of approximately 0.5 around x=2.5, not 0.8.

errors.text_span: След това тя запазва приблизително стойност до 6
errors.evidence: The blue line does not maintain its value; it clearly decreases gradually from its peak through x=6.
At x=8, the blue line's value is approximately 0.15, not 0.5.
The description fails to mention that there are two red dotted lines, which form a confidence interval.

errors.text_span: Червената пунктирана линия започва на стойност приблизително -0.2 и достига приблизително -0.7 към стойност 2. След това линията остава приблизително на -0.7, докато стойността на оста X достигне 8.
errors.evidence: This description of the red line is completely inaccurate. There are two red lines. The lower one starts around -0.6, peaks around -0.2, and ends around -0.4. The upper one starts around 0.8, peaks around 1.25, and ends around 0.8. The described values and trend do not match either line.

errors.text_span: Вътре в графиката има хоризонтален корициран блок, където стойностите на всяка ос варират между 0.6 и 0.9.
errors.evidence: There is no 'horizontal corrected block' or any similar feature in the chart. This part of the description is entirely fabricated.
